fact: The Libya MICS 2024-2025 household survey found internet use by women aged 15-49 at 75 per cent in urban and 66 per cent in rural areas, and internet access at home in 92 per cent of urban and 89 per cent of rural households.
title: Libya MICS7 2024-25 Statistical Snapshot
publisher: Bureau of Statistics and Census, with UNICEF
